name: comp-222
blurb: Select with icon for each option.
description: A select where each option displays an icon (from remixicon) next to text. Icons are aria-hidden and don't affect selection.
use_when: Visual recognition of options matters (e.g., frameworks, apps, brands).
avoid_when: Simple text lists or when icons aren't meaningful.
a11y: Icons are aria-hidden; text labels provide full meaning.
